locations.address: 1184 Bloor St W (brewery + music hall + kitchen)

claims.quote: Since 2015 … focusing on beers that are food friendly, refreshing, pale, and easy-drinking, mostly lagers and pale ales; Kensington expansion 'with a lager-forward beer program'
claims.source: own copy + news via search layer
claims.note: Matches ground truth (lagers, lighter beers, saisons). Third-party corroboration for lager QUALITY still thin — needs the fetch pass; keep tier honest.

claims.quote: Docklife collaborative Wild Saison (Lowlife x Burdock); smoked dark saison 'rich with coffee and a hint of chocolate'; Grape Ales inspired by wine
a kitchen, a brewery, and a stage under one roof — Brewery & Music Hall
claims.note: Music hall is a DISTINCT experience dimension no other pilot brewery has. Bloor only — Kensington must not inherit.

claims.quote: 'Tuesday' — an evolving saison series exploring different yeast strains, 'classic saison notes, spice, clove, fresh straw'; 'excels at hoppy, dry, and farmhouse/sour styles… considered a top 5 brewery in Ontario'; Ben's Beer Blog: 'Burdock Brewery is the real deal'
